steps.name: Wounded Townsfolk
steps.text: Ah! Schultz! That's where you were!

steps.name: Wounded Townsfolk
steps.text: I heard you were hurt. Are you being discharged?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *cough*... There are so many wounded. If this keeps up, we'll run out of beds.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tatjana... how is Tatjana?

steps.name: Wounded Townsfolk
steps.text: I- I'm not sure. I heard someone burned to death in front of her, and she...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Urk... Ahhh...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Let it out, child. Just let it all out.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I- I'm sorry... I just...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: A good cry is healthy.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But it's still chaos out there!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'll go. Between me, and the Rhodes Island team...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We'll figure it out.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: No... Don't tell me...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Take her to a bed. I'm taking command.

steps.name: Wounded Townsfolk
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Uncle...! Promise me! Promise me you won't get yourself killed!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: It's pointless.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It's pointless to even say it's pointless.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Have some hope, at least. There's always a chance to turn things around.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let me... through!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: We did it! We shattered the giants!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: This persistence... unexpected.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If you keep holding back, we won't make it out in one piece.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Your eyes are full of hatred, and emptiness.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You are angry about Dr. Atro. But what of it?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We all have our own baggage.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Don't you dare... speak her name.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Gah—!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: When winter comes, when the famine comes, you will still lose. No one will survive.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Wolumonde... will end.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That goes without saying.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Who is it you hate? Who are you going to save?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Grr! Those Arts again!

steps.name: Mudrock Colossus
steps.text: Gaaaaaaaah!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Delaying the time it takes for Mudrock's Arts to activate... what a strange ability.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But, do you really have the luxury to be getting distracted?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hey! L-let go of me!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're lucky. If you were a few years older, I'd have already hacked off your dominant hand.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Suzuran?!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Don't try to run.

steps.name: Mudrock Colossus
steps.text: GRAAAAAAAHHHH—!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You're just a medic. Don't try to fight.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Severin! You can't!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Another... warrior.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We found the real murderer.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The one behind everything! The traitor Biederman! Just moments ago brought to the Rathaus by the Rhodes Island operators!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Wait, Biederman... Biederman's still alive? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Don't listen to his bullshit! Does it even matter who the real murderer is?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: What we're fighting for is the end marginalization of the Infected, and the end to the aristocracy's exploitation of the working class! Winterwisp will rightfully reclaim its land!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: We are Reunion! A new era begins today!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Look, Severin, it's useless...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Then kill me, Reunion. Let's have a good fight.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: And then what? Winter and famine will still destroy this city.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It may be a dead end. But I'd rather believe Rhodes Island can keep things from getting worse.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: At least some will survive.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You see how bruised and battered you are. Your mask is half broken. Your giant is falling apart. And you're exhausted, aren't you?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I can tell. We're not so different, you and I.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Say, got a light?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It'll be my last cigarette anyway... Forget it.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: (Do it. Now. Don't give them a chance to save me.)

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Severin Hawthorn, when you die, I will leave this place.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: This is a ghost town. Staying here is just waiting to die.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I will tell them of your death. If they still wish to harm others, I shall personally deal with them.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...Fair enough.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Farewell.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: These Arts, what is this power...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Wh-why... must you die?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Get out of here, girl!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Don't die!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I have to... so that others can live!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hey! Mudrock's in trouble! Let's go help him! Don't let up!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: B-but they even broke the colossi...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Surrender.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Sarkaz is lost. What do you have to fight for?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: If you just need to vent your frustration, fine. I volunteer.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Until you're satisfied.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hurry! Fire up the Gramophone!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: I, I don't know Leithanian Arts. Go get us a Leithanian. What, what's that up there? A drone?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Don't look up! Look behind you! There's something with red eyes...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: You probably shouldn't move. GreyThroat has you in her sights.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Oh and you don't want to turn around and look for her either. I'm watching you too.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You seethe. You protect. How many times is this?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You... Heh, you actually beat me.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Drop your weapon. You're not getting away this time, Mudrock.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You'll leave them hating Wolumonde same as they always did!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Doesn't matter. They don't really want change. They only care about what's good for them.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: They could have worked together to get through the crisis. They didn't. They didn't care about the truth. They just wanted to loot and riot.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Miss Tatjana is right. Even if you sacrifice yourself, it won't help anything.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No matter how complex the backstory here is, a Rhodes Island operator won't sit by while Infected rioters destroy a town.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A town Atro wanted to protect.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A Rhodes Island op team will die defending this plaza, this town hall.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Really, this might lead to so much more death...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But that's after. After 'you' and after 'us.'

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: As long as we're still here, we'll fight to the end. So Atro can rest in peace.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You really have defeated me... Maybe you can actually defend this tower to the death. But... why?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Many will die.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Just like Atro. A meaningless death.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The Infected have a reason to fight.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: There's always a justification. But for now, you're not solving the problem. You're only causing destruction.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: After the Catastrophe struck Wolumonde, with supplies low and manpower short, what did you do?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Tell me. Tell me what you did!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You were told not to move.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Your Arts are so sloppy that at this distance, my crossbow is enough to incapacitate you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What led to that fire? And what did that fire lead to?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The mastermind is already dead.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Is he?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Retreat.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: What? But we just...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I said, retreat.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Only a few... can pass through the Great Rift and return to the land of warmth.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It doesn't matter if you want to take back your land or get revenge on the rich... You will only end up a corpse in the snow.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Do you want to spend the winter burning with rage? Do you want to warm yourselves with a fire fed with the bodies of innocents?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The murderer is dead. It's time to leave.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: B-but we have to take back Wolumonde! It's our land!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Quiet, Winterwisp. All you want is power. You want to cower behind the strong and pick up whatever scraps of power we leave behind.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't question the leader. Wise up, or you'll be six feet under.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Err...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: This isn't over!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: We lost so many people! Are we going to leave like that? With our tails between our legs? Just because of a few words?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Calm him down, friends.
Graaaaagh...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Gaaaah! A.... fist...?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: A stone fist from underground? You still have the strength?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You don't need to go that far just to stop them. They were on our side until a minute ago.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I wanted to scare them, but... never mind...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: And stop calling your Arts monsters 'friends.' It's creepy.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You don't have to listen. Leave me alone.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I have decided to retreat. I can't force you all to listen, but...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I am leaving. Those who follow me are also leaving.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Those who stay... you're on your own.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: By the way, do you have a match?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They might be wet. Those casters back there were a real pain.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Give a light to that Severin man.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Defeated warriors... are lucky to leave the battlefield alive. Don't dawdle.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Pfah! Forget about Reunion then! It's only a matter of time before we take the Rathaus. This town needs us!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Surrender, Severin!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I told you they wouldn't go down easily *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They're coming! Eyes left!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Get behind me.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Ugh. Bunch of lunatics.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rhodes Island is protecting this place. You have to go through us.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: They're going to use Arts. Prepare the defenses. Target the casters.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Wh- what? They blocked my Arts?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Why are you doing this?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Leader's orders.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Even if we have to fight you, devil, we're not giving up!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What happened? Are they fighting each other?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wait... Mudrock... stopped moving?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Leader?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Earth.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Arise...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Stop, Mudrock. You're burning through your own life.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Doesn't matter.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You don't have to use that ancient power—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I said... Arise!
All the rubble begins to condense into a single point.
A giant, looking out over the distant mountains.
Mudrock, however, stands motionless.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It's... huge!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: A last gasp. Its body is collapsing. He pushed himself too hard.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Fall back. Don't be hasty.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: N-no... Mudrock already spent all his energy. These Arts...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That's Sarkaz... witchcraft?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: (I said...)

steps.name: Mudrock Colossus
steps.text: I said...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: This is way too dangerous. You're sharing your life with your own creation. It's not worth it just to subdue them.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Fine. As you wish.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: (Shed your hate and strife. Live. This is your last chance to escape.)

steps.name: Mudrock Colossus
steps.text: Leave this place.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: (Those who still fight... only seek death for all.)

steps.name: Mudrock Colossus
steps.text: So... come destroy me.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Come defeat me!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Wh-why...? Didn't he come to help us? Is he not Reunion?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: I... I don't care! Screw him!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: In the past... we helped you. That fire unsettled us all.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We joined you, we guided you, but not for the sake of their deaths. Only for the sake of our lives.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Now, sadly, it looks like we're not on the same side.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Killing innocent people, and Rhodes Island's warriors, that's not our way.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: And if we're dealing with a bunch of rioters who don't follow orders, why show mercy?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Us, the Sarkaz, the 'devils,' we're enough to take on anyone.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: More than enough.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: What happened? Everything got quiet as soon as that giant appeared.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: So uh, that mountain-sized monster is a kind of Originium Art?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Let's figure out how to get back to Folinic.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Gah! Damn it!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Come on, let's go. This town is done for. We have to find a way over the Great Rift before winter sets in!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Abandon the town, Winterwisp clansmen, workers, and Infected.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: There are other places to exact our revenge. Leave Wolumonde to its fate!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: There's no reason to fight the Sarkaz. Fall back.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock, that's enough!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Phew... Haah... Haah...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They stopped... That was crazy. Since when are we in the conflict mediation business?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Look at this town... We, brought chaos.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It's not what we intended, but a rebellion is about self-interest, at its core. Not so many people come with high-minded ideals.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're right... So what do we do with our struggle...? With our deceased?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Loss and pain follow us everywhere.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Erm, just a second... I found a spare match.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hey, Gendarmerie, here.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Huh. Do Sarkaz warriors smoke?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I already quit.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: How about that. Looks like everyone who quits still carries matches.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Cherish your life.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: And you, Rhodes Islanders...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's time... to say goodbye.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Maybe... just maybe, you can find a way to help these people.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But none of that has anything to do with the Sarkaz anymore.
To the sound of crumbling rock, the Sarkaz turn and leave.
The entire block is burning.
The mob is gone, having left only out of fear.
The last chunk tumbles to the ground.
